name: Darren McCormick

bio.statement: The Portland Mercury, citing his LinkedIn profile, reports McCormick is a researcher, administrator and writer.
bio.excerpt: he is a researcher, administrator, and writer

verification.note: The Mercury attributes this description to McCormick's LinkedIn profile ('according to his LinkedIn profile, he is ...'). The original statement said he 'describes himself' this way, so the attribution was corrected. Re-fetched 2026-10-14.

bio.statement: The Portland Mercury reports McCormick is listed as 'Red Alliance' co-chair for Braver Angels of Portland.
bio.excerpt: listed as the “Red Alliance” co-chair for Braver Angels of Portland

verification.note: Excerpt confirmed verbatim in Portland Mercury (Mercury Election Strike Force, 2026-09-09), re-fetched 2026-10-14. Attribution, tier, paraphrase and neutrality checked.

positions.statement: In the occupation fields of his city filing form, McCormick wrote a call for more police and for locking up people he calls 'dangerously unstable drug zombies.'
positions.excerpt: More cops. Lock up the dangerously unstable drug zombies.

source.publisher: City of Portland Auditor's Office, Elections

verification.note: Excerpt confirmed verbatim in the 2026 City of Portland AUD-120 candidate filing form (Councilor District 3), re-fetched 2026-10-14. Attribution, tier, paraphrase and neutrality checked. The text appears verbatim in Q25, Q26 and Q27 of the form. The statement attributes the quoted wording to McCormick.

gaps: No voters' pamphlet statement: the county pamphlet's candidate index marks this candidate with an asterisk ('did not file a candidate statement'), and no statement is linked in the county's Military & Overseas Online Voters' Guide
Filing form background fields contain campaign slogans rather than occupation or education
No campaign website listed on the filing form
Did not respond to the Portland Tribune candidate Q&A
No voting record (has not held elected office)

verification_summary.balance_notes: Race portland-council-d3 (21 candidates). Every candidate was searched in the same shared sources: the Mercury (2026-09-09), OPB (2026-10-07), the Tribune Q&A (2026-10-13), the Multnomah pamphlet and the 2026 AUD-120 forms. The pamphlet candidate index marks this candidate with an asterisk ('did not file a candidate statement'). The thin profile is a non-filer gap, not missed effort. McCormick has 2 bio items and 1 position. The form's occupation, background and experience fields repeat a slogan, which supports the gap. The 'did not respond to Tribune' gap is confirmed, and OPB does not name him. One attribution was corrected. Incumbent=false confirmed.
